items.title: Template website
items.text: Pick one of the 5 templates above. I replace the photos and texts with yours — the site looks just the same, with every animation, only with your content.

items.title: Custom landing page
items.text: A one-page website built from scratch: your own design and effects, made for your goal and your style.

items.title: Multi-page website
items.text: The first page is €300, each next page from €150 depending on complexity. One consistent style and clear navigation.

services.note: A custom site starts with a conversation — no call needed. Message me on WhatsApp, Instagram or Telegram, tell me what you want, and we'll work out the details.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: We talk however suits you — messages or a call. We go through the goal and examples you like.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: I build the style, structure and first screen. We refine it until you say “wow”.

steps.title: Development
steps.text: Layout, animations, mobile. You get a live link and watch it come together.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: I check speed and mobile, connect your domain and publish the site.
